custodyProfile.uncertainty: 2026-09-29: JPYSC is a trust-type Type III Electronic Payment Instrument; SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, as issuer-trustee, holds the backing assets as trust property segregated from its own assets under the FSA framework, with SBI VC Trade as issuing entity giving investment instructions. The underlying deposit banks for the yen demand-deposit portion and the custody venue of the JGB positions are not disclosed, and no rehypothecation terms are published; shares between custodial arrangements are therefore omitted rather than estimated.
